advantage_gate: Capability-qualified and complete stable-source 16-cell cohort with complete token usage; HIA query must pass all four hidden task gates, succeed at least as often as Rust query, consume no more task input+output tokens than Rust query, and consume fewer tokens than HIA full without reducing successes. Report within-language and between-language contrasts separately; this is descriptive, not population statistical superiority.
cell_order: Rotate the four arms by task index; one chosen model for all 16 main cells. No model switching or task substitution in the cohort.
costs: input/output token IDs and unknown usage
self-check tokens and all public-feedback repairs in calibration and main
received partial output token lower bounds and unknown residual usage
edit_authority: Both interfaces may replace the same complete provider and consumer definitions. No answer inventory, gold function body, hidden case, or hidden expected value is put in model prompts or decoder schemas.
execution_location: Available shared development host, not verified dot. LOCAL_RUNTIME_NOT_OBSERVABLE.
feedback: Same original public inputs, expected/observed values, aggregate resource/VM verdicts and actual compiler/admission diagnostics, now paired by case with entrypoint/provider_probe labels. No new example, hidden input, repair code or task-specific hint. At most two automatic repairs; hidden validation remains terminal after the first public pass.
full_context: All four physical source files, including unchanged audit_tag and utility definitions. An independent provider-probe harness is compiler instrumentation, not an editable project file.
hia_file_scope: Four source files are assembled into one verified HIA Core module; this is not independent HIA object-module linking.

model_selection.eligibility: All three unchanged baseline task gates must pass within three submissions under the new profile. No inherited eligibility; main forbidden unless fresh v6 calibration passes.
model_selection.reason: Independent rustc metadata compilation of the unchanged original 7B scalar reply succeeded. The v5 scalar rejection was an interface restriction; its owner arithmetic error remained a real semantic failure. The already completed v5 1.5B trials are retained rather than repeated without an additional model-selection reason.
model_selection.selection_bias: Adaptive follow-up: the pinned 7B model produced legal Rust refused by the v5 interface and passed the API-upgrade task. This is not an unbiased model or pipeline sample.

predecessor: v4 and v5 results remain immutable; no historical answer is rescored.
query_context: Exact editable definitions plus unchanged function signatures and call/effect interface summary; omitted definitions are retained and reverified.
resource_execution: Actual bounded native execution and independently recorded HIA VM ownership/loan observations; resource observations are not whole-compiler proofs.

rust_conversion_profile.scope: Only a bare identifier naming a declared scalar function parameter may receive .into(). Macro definitions and dollar-sign metavariables are excluded in every file under this opt-in profile, including files without a literal into call. No arguments, container/field/expression receivers, parameter shadowing, closures/bar syntax or complex let patterns in a file using into. Other v4 syntax/type/effect limits remain. Actual target conversion validity is decided by real rustc. No generated source is rewritten.

selection_scope: The profile and feedback both change prospectively. Differences from v5 cannot be attributed independently to language, model capability, into support or feedback.
self_check: Syntax-only JSON check string preceding files, at most1536 characters, generic requirement review, unscored and with no source-edit authority; no answer inventory or hidden cases.
timeout: A timeout ends that cell and retains unknown output usage; stop the owned model process and start a fresh one for the next distinct cell. Never relabel a missing response as zero tokens or retry a timed-out cell.
transport: Owned Unix-socket llama.cpp b11669 SSE; exact input IDs and received output IDs retained before EOF. Partial output is a lower bound, complete total is null without a validated final event.
